Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
Experience with high-volume cold calling
Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
SFDC familiarity
Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders.

Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company.

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.

For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements.

Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers (Sudoeste), Argentina — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.
We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Argentina.
You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal.

As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.
Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.
Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.
Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.
Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.
Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.
Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.
Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.
Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.
Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.

A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.
Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.
Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.
Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.
Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.
A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.
Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

s.h: Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.
s.t:
Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.
A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
Halter in Argentina
Argentina is one of the largest beef producers and exporters in the world, with a deep grazing tradition across the Pampas and beyond. This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. As an Commercial (Mid-Market) Account Executive, you'll partner with some of Japan's most innovative and fast-growing companies - helping them unlock the full potential of their data to scale faster and smarter. You will own an Emerging territory, a portfolio of high‑potential, under‑penetrated accounts (often SMBs and Mid-market) that are not yet covered by a dedicated account owner.
You are a strategic, growth-minded sales professional who thrives in dynamic environments. You understand how to engage with senior stakeholders, navigate complex organizations, and drive meaningful outcomes. You're comfortable managing both short-term opportunities and multi-threaded, strategic initiatives that expand our footprint and customer impact.
You will report to Sr Manager, Sales in Japan.

Develop and execute a territory plan targeting Japan’s emerging market segment - growth-stage organizations with significant data and AI ambitions.
Effectively manage a mix of rapid, transactional deals and complex, strategic engagements.
Consistently meet and exceed activity, pipeline, and revenue goals through active prospecting and account development.
Maintain high standards of operational excellence in Salesforce and Clari, including accurate forecasting, opportunity tracking (MEDDPICC), and detailed account notes.
Lead with a customer-first mindset and focus on delivering measurable business value.

3+ years of closing experience in SaaS, Cloud, Big Data or AI sales.
Proven success exceeding sales KPIs and quotas.
Demonstrated ability to acquire new customers and expand existing relationships.

About Databricks

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.
Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .
Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.
Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo
Nuestro equipo de Key Account Manager trabaja bajo el modelo “híbrido”, siendo necesario estar presencialmente en la oficina, ubicada en Buenos Aires, 2 veces por semana.
Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío
El Hunter de Expansión es un perfil netamente estratégico y de apertura de mercado. Su misión principal es desembarcar y consolidar la presencia de la compañía en nuevas zonas geográficas, nuevas plazas o verticales de negocio no exploradas (como abrir nuevas zonas en GBA o penetrar el modelo híbrido en el interior). No maneja cartera existente; su foco es el crecimiento desde cero,
Tus Responsabilidades
Apertura de Nuevas Plazas: Liderar la estrategia de entrada comercial en nuevas geografías, mapeando competidores locales y detectando barreras de entrada.
Captación Agresiva (Paid Publisher): Introducir los modelos de monetización y planes premium de la compañía en el nuevo mercado, logrando los primeros cierres clave.
Generación de Demanda Local: Desarrollar relaciones sólidas desde cero con los principales actores del mercado objetivo (inmobiliarias locales, desarrolladores)
Alianza con Operaciones: Trabajar de la mano con los equipos de producto y marketing para adaptar el discurso comercial a las particularidades culturales y económicas de la nueva plaza.
Growth Comercial: Asegurar que la nueva plaza alcance la masa crítica de listing o facturación necesaria en los plazos estipulados por el Business Plan (BP).
Lo que buscamos (Requisitos)
Experiencia: Mínimo 3 a 5 años en roles de desarrollo de negocio ( Business Development ), ventas corporativas de campo (territoriales) o expansión en empresas de tecnología/proptech.
Habilidades Blandas: Autonomía extrema, pensamiento estratégico, visión de negocio, adaptabilidad al cambio y habilidades de comunicación a nivel ejecutivo.

Beyond external sales, you'll be a key internal evangelist for commerce media — helping cross functional teams, such as Growth Marketing and Partner Marketing, understand how our advertising solutions can act as a multiplier for their own goals, not just a standalone revenue line. You'll be equally comfortable pitching a brand-side CMO and pitching an internal XFN lead on why this matters.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record in programmatic and social platform sales and/or senior level account management, thrives in ambiguity, and has genuine entrepreneurial instincts — someone who wants to shape a business from the ground up rather than execute inside an established one.
You Will
Own the full lifecycle of a book of business — from prospecting and closing new programmatic and social partnerships (endemic and non-endemic) to managing, retaining, and growing those relationships post-sale.
Translate advertiser objectives into strategic programmatic campaigns using our ad formats, audience targeting, insights, and measurement tools — and oversee execution to ensure flawless delivery.
Serve as the primary client contact across the relationship lifecycle, building trusted relationships with brand and agency-side stakeholders top-down and bottoms-up.
Evangelize commerce media internally — partnering with internal functions to position our advertising solutions as a multiplier for their existing goals, not a separate initiative.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Strategy & Ops, Data Science, Product, Marketing and Payments to surface client feedback, inform roadmap priorities, collaborate strategically on endemic Enterprise merchants and ensure advertiser needs are represented.
Identify and pitch new growth opportunities — new formats, new surfaces, new pilots — both to external clients and internal stakeholders.
Inform the foundation as you go: sales narratives, case studies, playbooks, and enablement materials that don't exist yet but will be needed as the team scales.
Monitor campaign performance and deliver actionable insights and optimization recommendations that drive ROI and retention.
Stay ahead of industry trends — DSP innovation, privacy changes, audience targeting shifts, commerce media developments — to act as a trusted advisor both externally and internally.
You Have
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, communications, or related field.
7-10+ years of experience in programmatic advertising, spanning sales and/or account management, within a retail media network, digital publisher, agency trading desk, or DSP/SSP platform.
A track record of both closing new business and growing existing accounts — comfortable operating across the full client lifecycle.
Solid understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, audience targeting, measurement, attribution, and brand safety.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence both external partners and internal stakeholders across functions.
Comfortable working in ambiguous, cross-functional environments and collaborating closely with Strategy & Ops, Data Science, Partnerships, Ad Ops, Product and Partner Marketing.
A builder's mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, undefined process, and being a catch-all in the early days of a new function.
Passion for digital advertising and commerce media; experience in fintech, retail, or commerce-related businesses is a strong plus.

Peu importe tes études ou ton passé professionnel, nous cherchons les traits de caractère suivants :
Le sens de la conviction : Tu n'hésites pas à donner ton avis, même face à une figure d'autorité. Tu préfères une discussion franche au consensus facile.
Une résilience sans faille : L'échec te pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Un "non" n'est jamais une fin en soi, mais le point de départ pour trouver une autre solution.
Le goût de l'accomplissement : Tu as besoin de te fixer des défis pour avancer. Tu aimes la compétition et tu cherches un environnement où tes efforts sont récompensés à leur juste valeur.
Une curiosité naturelle : Tu aimes creuser un sujet pour en comprendre les racines. Tu poses les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant d'agir.
Le sens de l'autonomie : Tu apprécies la liberté d'organiser tes journées et tu sais faire preuve d'une grande rigueur personnelle pour atteindre tes objectifs.

0 à 3 ans d'expérience après la fin de tes études.

Français parfait et niveau avancé en anglais (C1\).
Permis de conduire (catégorie B).

Un écosystème de high\-performers : Un environnement exigeant et stimulant où l'on se tire vers le haut et où les succès sont célébrés ensemble (voyages, kick\-offs).
L'impact comme véritable moteur : Tu auras un impact direct sur le business de tes clients et sur la trajectoire des jeunes talents.

Strategic Execution & Optimization: Own the full campaign lifecycle—from initial strategy and pitch to setup and execution—across Paid Search, Social, and Web, while conducting regular platform checks to ensure optimal performance.

Operational Agility: Handle additional duties as assigned and travel as necessary to support client needs and business objectives.

Demonstrated time management and project management skills
A positive attitude that resonates throughout your team and the company
Demonstrated familiarity with Google products (Gmail, Docs, Slides, Drive) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) products
Nice-To-Haves
2-plus years' experience building multi-faceted digital marketing campaigns, including SEO, SEM, PPC, Social and email marketing services

Experience using a project management tool, preferably JIRA
Experience working with or in the automotive industry

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the Canterbury region. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change, working with some of the highest-performing dairy farms in New Zealand.

Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability.

You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the South Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have.
Location - This role is to be based anywhere in the South Canterbury region. Frequent travel is required as part of the position.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region.
Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business.
Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance.
Deployment: Supporting the onboarding, training and implementation of the Halter system on customers' farms, ensuring all relevant farm owners, managers, and workers are able to successfully use the system.
Relationship Building: Proactively cultivate genuine and trustworthy relationships with farmers, their teams, and families, fostering strong connections and understanding.
Farmer Success: Strategically partnering with customers to establish clear business goals, timelines, priorities and metrics of success.
Problem-Solving: Provide prompt and effective communication and support to farmers and team members, addressing technical or operational challenges with expertise and efficiency.
Community & Networking: Represent the Halter brand with pride, lead local discussion groups, and proactively build strong networks within the community for increased brand visibility and connections.
Customer Advocate: Acting as the voice of the customer and bridging the gap with our product teams to provide important context about what is happening on the ground with our farmers and their animals.
Technical Expertise : Working closely with our product teams to provide technical and practical advice from a farmer’s perspective on everything reproduction, pasture and agronomy.
Contribute to a positive team environment, supporting others to succeed and role modelling Halter’s Operating Principles.
We’re backing potential over polish. These are the traits that matter most:
A great human first
You bring integrity, humility, and care. You do what you say you’ll do. You show up for your farmers and your teammates.
Lifelong learner mindset
You’re genuinely curious. You ask questions, seek feedback, and are excited to keep leveling up alongside a world‑class team.
Hunger and grit
You love chasing ambitious goals, solving hard problems, and sticking with it when things get tough.
Positive energy and team spirit
You lift the people around you, not drain them. You enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and celebrating others’ wins as much as your own.
Comfort in a fast‑moving environment
You’re at your best when things are dynamic. You can work autonomously, manage your time well, and stay focused on what matters most.
Experience that helps you hit the ground running
A background in relationship management, account management, sales, or working closely with customers.
Experience in dairy or the wider ag sector is a bonus, but not a deal breaker if you bring strong learning agility and a genuine passion for helping farmers succeed.
A foundation of business acumen and a willingness to deepen it on the job.
If you’re excited by the idea of working with an exceptional South Island team, spending time on farm with great people, and helping farmers become leaders in productivity and sustainability, we’d love to hear from you.

3-5 years of experience in relationship management/account management roles.
Experience in dairy farming or within the agriculture sector with a deep passion for helping farmers succeed.
Strong business acumen.
Positive attitude and collaborative team player who excels at overcoming challenges.
The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.
A hunger for success and personal growth, and an eagerness to evolve alongside a world-class team.

Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.
We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.
Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory.

The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.
The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts.

The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

Territory Strategy & Business Performance
Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.
Strategic Account Management & Network Development
Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.
Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement
Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.
Influence & Impact
Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries
Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact
Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights
Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.
Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture
Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.

We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.
We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

You’ll do whatever it takes to get those companies on Watershed and help them be effective. Sell Watershed. Find your way to the right people at leading companies, educate them about effective climate programs, and help them succeed with Watershed.
You’ll own the full lifecycle, from first outbound to contract signature.
Shape Watershed’s GTM strategy and help Watershed break into new market segments.
Influence Watershed’s product strategy by sharing feedback from customers on the front line.
Become an expert in climate, and educate companies on how they should navigate the world of carbon reduction targets, clean energy, carbon removal, and decarbonising their supply chain.
Help build the sales team.

Are excited to lead from zero to one. You love to build things from scratch—new playbooks for navigating organizations and ways to tell the Watershed story.
Are an excellent consultative seller. You listen deeply to customers and excel by helping them solve their problems.
Love going deep on new domains. You’ve sold products in complex or technical fields, and relish becoming an expert on your subject matter. You’re voraciously curious. You’re excited to learn everything about climate and help companies navigate this space.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

As the Corporate Account Manager Lead, you'll lead a team of Account Managers across our highest-velocity, highest-volume post-sales segment. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value across a large, fast-moving book of accounts.
This is a revenue-critical role at an inflection point: ElevenLabs is scaling fast, and Corporate is where that scale shows up first - more accounts, more velocity, and less room for anything that doesn't repeat well.

The decisions you make around segmentation, playbook design, and how AI agents and automation get embedded into everyday AM workflows will define how this motion performs as volume keeps growing. Making ElevenAgents the agent of choice across the Corporate portfolio is a core part of that expansion playbook.

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Corporate Account Management team, owning team quota performance, retention, expansion, and cross sell goals across a high-volume book of business.
Drive revenue outcomes as a core mandate - building a team culture where expansions and cross-sells are owned with the same rigor as any quota-carrying sales function.
Design and implement repeatable, scalable playbooks for renewals, expansion, and adoption that hold up across hundreds of accounts, not just a handful.
Embed AI agents and automation into AM workflows by default, so the team can manage growing volume without simply adding headcount.
Champion AI fluency across the team: set expectations, build capability, and create an environment where every AM is actively experimenting with and adopting AI-powered approaches to their work.
Set strategic direction for how the Corporate segment is structured and staffed as the business scales, partnering closely with RevOps, Comp/Finance, and CX leadership.
Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, tooling, and revenue strategy.

5+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, Customer Success, or post-sales roles within SaaS, ideally with meaningful exposure to high-volume, transactional or corporate-segment books of business.
Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets (renewals, expansion, NRR/GRR, cross sell), with a clear commercial instinct.
2+ years of direct people leadership experience - managing AMs/CSMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for building a high-performance, feedback-driven culture grounded in accountability and customer impact.
Deep AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own daily workflow, understand what AI agents and automation can do, and are ready to lead a team through a meaningful shift in how work gets designed and executed.
Strong player-coach mindset: comfortable managing accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.
Expertise in post-sales methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling) adapted for a high-volume, scaled motion.
Strategic operational thinking: able to make sound calls on segmentation, playbook design, and process at scale as account volume grows.
Strong analytical and operational skills: adept at using data to identify performance trends, optimize workflows, and forecast outcomes across a large book.
Bonus: Hands-on with tools (ElevenLabs, Salesforce, Gong, Lemlist, Sigma) and capable of improving data quality, visibility, and usage insights across the team.
Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the U.S., with the ability to operate between GMT-4 and GMT-7 timezones required. We'd love for you to be based in New York or San Francisco where you can work out of our office, but it's not a requirement.

Abacus ist fast schon das Microsoft der Schweiz. Über 60’000 KMU setzen auf die ERP\-Lösung aus St. Gallen – und immer mehr davon auch auf integrierte Data\- \& Analytics\-Lösungen, um Transparenz, Steuerung und Effizienz zu erhöhen. AXEPT gehört zu den führenden Abacus\-Partnern und unterstützt Kunden dabei, ihre Daten gezielt nutzbar zu machen. Unser Data\-\&\-Analytics\-Bereich wächst stark – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.
**Das macht deinen Alltag spannend:**
* Gewinnung neuer Kunden und Projekte im Bereich Data\-, Reporting\- und Analytics\-Lösungen rund um Abacus und andere Lösungen
* Identifikation, Qualifizierung und Priorisierung von Leads sowie eigenständiger Aufbau und Pflege der Sales\-Pipeline
* Ganzheitliche Steuerung des Vertriebsprozesses von der Erstansprache über Präsentationen und Angebotsverhandlungen bis zum Abschluss
* Analyse der Kundenanforderungen im Bereich Reporting, Controlling und Analytics und Entwicklung passender Lösungskonzepte
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams wie D\&A\-Team, Sales\-Team, Projects, Product \& Innovation sowie Backoffice zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
* Beobachtung von Markt\- und Technologietrends im Bereich Data \& Analytics und aktive Weitergabe im Sales\-Team
**Das bringst du mit:**
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management, Consulting oder Lösungsverkauf – idealerweise im Data\-, Analytics\- oder Software\-Umfeld
* Freude an aktiver Neukundenakquisition und am Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
* Ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, KPIs und Reporting\-Anforderungen
* Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe Daten\-Themen verständlich zu erklären
* Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten
* Unternehmerisches Denken und den Anspruch, deine Umsatzziele eigenständig zu erreichen
* Starkes Interesse an Data, Analytics, BI und Digitalisierung
* Kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung – kombiniert mit Erfahrung in Beratung oder Verkauf
* Kenntnisse von Abacus, BI\-Tools oder Reporting\-Lösungen sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
**Und das hast du dann davon:**
* Einen anspruchsvollen, aber superspannenden Job, in den wir dich vor Ort gut einarbeiten. Und wenn du sattelfest bist, gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
